title: Git commit violating Conventional Commits format
user_message: The auth.py changes are already staged. Commit them with an appropriate message.

response.message: pre-commit hook rejected: commit message must follow Conventional Commits. Required format: type(scope): description — where type is one of feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|test|chore, scope is the module name in parentheses, description is at least 5 chars. Example: 'feat(auth): add SHA-256 password hashing'
